title: 一种用于制备嘧菌酯中间体的催化体系及嘧菌酯的制备方法（CN112403514B）
publisher: CNIPA patent document via Google Patents
t0_eligibility_basis: Current-state study; A-publication 2021-02-26 and B-grant 2023-05-19 are publicly available.
archive_note: Application CN202011377891.4 / ZL202011377891.4; filing 2020-11-30; assignee 河北威远生物化工有限公司. Claims a preparation method for azoxystrobin using a composite catalyst of tetramethyl tertiary diamine (e.g. TMEDA/TMPDA) + sulfone cosolvent (DMSO/sulfolane), with milder temperature control vs DABCO/copper-salt prior art. Spec examples report intermediate yields; no official product→patent mapping in the document itself.
